title: valeriana eriocarpa
intro: Valeriana eriocarpa, commonly known as Western valerian, is a perennial plant species in the family Valerianaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, such as anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness, due to its health benefits in promoting relaxation and reducing stress. The therapeutic actions of Valeriana eriocarpa include sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its calming effects on the nervous system. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include valerenic acid, isovaleric acid, and valepotriates, which are compounds known for their ability to interact with the GABA receptor and promote relaxation.
